source.document: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Greenwashing, 2024

explain.en: Eco-labels and green certification claims require an authorized certification scheme and verifiable license/registration details.

remediation.en: Specify the accredited certification scheme (e.g. BIS Ecomark) and display the verifiable license code.

tests.input: Certified green packaging for home delivery
tests.notes: Vague green seal claim without scheme details

tests.input: BIS certified packaging under Ecomark scheme (license no: CM/L-1234567)
tests.notes: Official Ecomark scheme and license code
